name: git-tooling
description: Git tooling for Claude Code — default-branch commit prompt, bulk worktree force-remove guard, force-push guard, wt-done merged-branch cleanup, gh-resolve-threads PR review-thread triage, PR-aware push reminders, on-demand CI status watching with failing-check names surfaced inline, release watching (GitHub Release + GHCR package publishes), and the Release Ticker mod: a status line that follows each `gh pr merge` through release run, tag, GitHub Release and registry digest, and nags when a floating tag wasn't moved

releaseWorkflow.title: Release workflow
releaseWorkflow.description: Workflow file the Release Ticker follows after a merge (under .github/workflows/). A repo without it is skipped silently.

registry.title: Container registry
registry.description: Registry whose digest the Release Ticker waits for when the repo publishes a package named after it. Only ghcr.io is read (through the GitHub Packages API); any other value skips the digest stage.

floatingTagRepos.title: Floating-tag repos
floatingTagRepos.description: Entries of the form owner/repo:tag (e.g. owner/workflows:v1). After a merge in such a repo, the Release Ticker nags when the floating tag still isn't on the new release (or merge) commit once the release resolves or the watch times out.

timeoutMin.title: Release watch timeout (minutes)
timeoutMin.description: Hard stop for a Release Ticker watch, in minutes after the merge.
